levels.name: role_facades
levels.description: Role-named facades over one infra service each. Expose Database() / Cache() / Queue() / Vector() / Storage() / Store() / Vault() / Graph() user-facing classes.

levels.name: bootstraps
levels.description: Process-level runtime wiring (FastAPI factory, queue-consumer hosts).

extras.label: Logging
extras.role: Structured logging protocol + request-id context propagation.

extras.label: ISO Dates
extras.role: Canonical ISO-8601 date/time formatting and parsing — always UTC.

extras.label: Errors
extras.role: AppError hierarchy + envelope shape + http exception mapper.

extras.label: Base Types
extras.role: Base Pydantic models, frozen value objects, JSON-Schema conventions.

extras.label: Database
extras.role: Relational/ACID structured-state (Postgres/SQLAlchemy): Database handle, BaseDBModel + substrate_base, AuditMixin, and the DDL/reflect/filters/pagination/locks/identifiers/integrity primitives every higher package builds on.

extras.label: Cache
extras.role: Key-value cache (Redis): get/set, decorators, prefix invalidation.

extras.label: Queue
extras.role: Async job queue (Redis/arq): tasks, enqueue, JobCtx.

extras.label: Vector
extras.role: Vector store + similarity search (Qdrant): CollectionHandle, VectorPoint, search.

extras.label: Storage
extras.role: Object/blob storage (S3/MinIO): presigned URLs, presigned POST.

extras.label: Object Store
extras.role: Schemaless document records (BSON/JSON shape, eventual consistency), MongoDB-backed. Distinct from [storage], which holds opaque binary blobs.

extras.label: Graph
extras.role: In-memory multi-edge typed-graph algebra. Graph() with BFS/DFS/closure/cycle, deterministic edge IDs, JSON export. No infra dep.

extras.label: Grid
extras.role: Tabular state pillar — typed cells, rows, cell-pinned edges, recursive-CTE traversal, JSON-Schema import/export. Pure-tabular: no VECTOR/FILE handlers.

extras.label: Space
extras.role: Multi-grid bundle + rich-content wrapper (VECTOR/FILE field types) + cross-grid traversal + SyncSourceConfig contract.

extras.label: Flow
extras.role: Durable workflow execution. Tasks, runs, step events, scheduled runs.

extras.label: API Server
extras.role: FastAPI factory: standard middleware stack, lifespan, typed health probes, error envelope with HTTP status mapping.

extras.label: Worker
extras.role: Queue-consumer hosts: Worker (async lifecycle + awaitable run) run standalone, embedded in a host loop, or one per OS process.
